guide.name: 2026 MICHELIN Guide Southwest
guide.cityList: 24 Las Vegas distinctions: 4 starred (5 stars), 3 Bib Gourmand, 17 Recommended
guide.sourceLabel: Visit Las Vegas (Las Vegas Convention and Visitors Authority) — official MICHELIN list page
guide.note: 2027 awards have not been announced. A 2026 distinction is not a guarantee of 2027 status.

rows.name: Joël Robuchon
rows.hours: Tue–Sat 5:00–9:30 PM. Closed Sunday and Monday.
rows.priceNote: Menu listed on the official page without prices. A two-person total is not published.
rows.note: $$$$ · Business Formal dress code · Reservations 702.891.7925 · children under 6 not accepted. Awarded Two Stars, 2026 (only Las Vegas restaurant with two). Also a 2026 MICHELIN Service Award (Sean Christopher) and Forbes Five-Star.

rows.name: é by José Andrés
rows.hours: Tue–Sat, two seatings 5:30–8:30 PM (logged on the official page 2026-11-26).
rows.note: Intimate tasting-menu room; a prior logged session recorded that tickets release three months ahead, which is relevant for a February 2027 booking.

rows.name: L'Atelier de Joël Robuchon
rows.hours: Mon and Thu–Sun 5:00–9:30 PM; closed Tue–Wed (logged on the official page 2026-11-26).
rows.note: Counter-style room from the same kitchen group as Joël Robuchon, at a lower price point.

rows.name: Restaurant Guy Savoy
rows.hours: Weekly schedule not published on the captured page (it showed 'Closed · Opens 5:00 PM').
rows.priceNote: À la carte only, effective 11/5/2026: $60 (cheese cart) to $290 (Japanese A5 wagyu) per item; e.g. Colors of Caviar $120, Artichoke & Black Truffle Soup $100, Sea Bass $160, Marmite of Squab $200. No fixed two-person total is published.

social.label: Caesars Palace Instagram (property account, official footer link)

rows.note: $$$$ · Formal · 9-course Krug table (only one in North America) · over 12,000 bottles and a Wine Spectator Grand Award. Address 3570 Las Vegas Blvd S.

rows.name: China Poblano
rows.priceNote: A prior session logged a $60/person dining anchor; the current official page did not restate it.
rows.note: Bib Gourmand — the guide's value category. Walk-in friendly per the official Las Vegas MICHELIN FAQ.

rows.name: Esther's Kitchen
rows.note: Bib Gourmand, Downtown. Best paired with Mob Museum / Neon Museum days.

rows.name: Yen Viet Kitchen

rows.note: Recommended (listed). The only restaurant in this set with exact two-person totals published. Cannot accommodate vegan, dairy-free, celiac, or garlic/onion-free diets.
